facts.title: Maya Girls' Blue Cotton Sweater Top with Handmade Flowers
facts.materialText: Indulge her in a little luxury with our Maya Blue Cotton Sweater Top. Made from soft, premium cotton with a touch of stretch, this top pairs everyday comfort with sophisticated style. The rich blue color is reminiscent of a clear sky, and handmade flowers add a sweet, special finish. Style it with the matching pieces from our Maya Collection for a coordinated lounge set, or pair it with her favorite bottoms for an easy, elegant outfit. Available in sizes 6 months to 12 years. Soft 95% Cotton, 5% Elastane Handmade Flowers Made to Match our Maya Collection Made in Turkey Care Instructions: Hand wash or machine wash in cold water, delicate cycle. Hang to dry.
